policy: A mismatch is the most valuable artifact in the project. No unexplained residual disappears from history (docs/COURTS.md §Residual discipline).

residuals.oracle_fingerprint: sync db cachyos has 0 linux-cachyos entries; rootfs /etc/pacman.conf is stock Arch (no [cachyos])
residuals.root_cause: pacstrap installs the pacman package whose /etc/pacman.conf default overwrites the CachyOS config copied by the builder; the oracle's libalpm then registers only core/extra and linux-cachyos vanishes from discovery.
residuals.resolution: provision-rootfs.sh restores the cachyos-first pacman.conf after pacstrap; base image rebuilt (reference_image_hash updated in UPSTREAM.lock).
residuals.regression_witness: court kernel-discovery/minimal passes; pacman -Sl cachyos shows linux-cachyos

residuals.candidate_fingerprint: inspect dump SIGKILL (guest OOM, 7.7GB anon rss); strace shows infinite brk/mmap doubling
residuals.root_cause: RawList declared alpm_list_t with only {data,next}; the real struct has {data,prev,next} so `next` was read at the prev offset, corrupting list walks into an infinite allocation loop.
residuals.resolution: added the prev field (ffi.rs); list walks now correct.
residuals.regression_witness: db_packages returns 205/177/7340 packages on the host; all courts pass

residuals.candidate_fingerprint: inspect dump SIGSEGV (139); gdb: garbage pointer 0x347265766e7a ('znver4') in local_pkg
residuals.root_cause: alpm_pkg_get_installed_db returns const char* (the provenance db NAME), not alpm_db_t*; calling alpm_db_get_name on the string pointer produced garbage.
residuals.resolution: declared the correct return type; local_pkg reads the name string.

residuals.root_cause: misread of km-window.cpp:97-104: the `continue` in init_kernels_tree_widget fires AFTER the QTreeWidgetItem was inserted, so a kernel installed from a different repo REMAINS in the tree, unchecked and not immutable — it is NOT omitted.
residuals.resolution: removed the candidate's row-skip; the row is emitted with checked=false, immutable=false, version marker computed from the row's own sync package.

residuals.oracle_fingerprint: ALERT node carries only the window title; the 'No kernels found!' message is on a LABEL child
residuals.candidate_fingerprint: comparator reported oracle dialog condition false
residuals.root_cause: the dialog normalizer read only the ALERT/DIALOG/WINDOW node's own text; Qt puts the message on a descendant label.
residuals.resolution: dialog extraction gathers descendant text (depth-limited) and prefers the longest (most specific) message.

residuals.oracle_fingerprint: oracle tree reported rows_populated=False while the dump visibly contained 17 rows
residuals.root_cause: pyatspi2 getRole() returns plain ints on this stack; the observer compared role NAMES against numeric strings, and the Qt tree is a FLAT list of TABLE_CELLs with no TREE_ITEM wrappers.
residuals.resolution: observer maps numeric AT-SPI role ids; wait_for_rows detects the flat layout; normalizer chunks flat TABLE_CELL runs into rows.

residuals.oracle_fingerprint: residual.json invalid: missing comma after fixture_marker_present; newline inside sha256 strings; unescaped quotes
residuals.root_cause: residual.sh hand-built JSON: missing comma, awk print newlines, no quote escaping, and set -e could truncate the file on a failing probe.
residuals.resolution: fixed comma/escaping/tr newline stripping; removed set -e so evidence capture degrades fields instead of truncating.
residuals.regression_witness: residual.json validates on host and in VM

residuals.oracle_fingerprint: host OOM killer killed zed-editor (11GB anon rss) while a 16GiB court VM ran
residuals.root_cause: qemu VMs allocated 16GiB RAM unconstrained on a memory-stressed host; the host reached global OOM.
residuals.resolution: qemu runs in systemd user scopes with MemoryMax/MemorySwapMax (12G/4G); VM RAM 16G->8G + virtio-balloon; docker builders capped; stale-qemu detection + cleanup subcommand.
residuals.regression_witness: cgroup limits verified (memory.max=12G) on running VMs
